heroLead: Focal BI is FDS’s analytics workspace, customized on Apache Superset. Drag a chart or write SQL. The warehouse you already run stays the source of truth — no extra ingestion layer.

card2Need: Screenshot SQL Lab with a query, results grid, and schema browser. Save as /assets/focal-bi/sql-lab.png.
card3Need: Screenshot a physical or virtual dataset with columns and metrics. Save as /assets/focal-bi/datasets.png.
pillarsTitle: Powerful, without a specialist for every chart.
pillarsLead: Apache Superset is the open-source core. FDS customizes it so teams can explore, publish, and govern dashboards on the SQL engines they already operate.
pillar0Body: Explore with a no-code viz builder, or drop into a state-of-the-art SQL IDE. Same data. Two ways in.
pillar1Body: Connect any SQL-based engine — including cloud-native warehouses at petabyte scale. Query where the data already lives.
pillar2Body: Lightweight and highly scalable. It rides your existing data infrastructure instead of asking for yet another ingestion layer.
pillar3Body: Forty-plus chart types ship ready. A plug-in architecture makes custom visualizations a first-class path, not a fork.
desksTitle: Four desks. Anyone can open a board.
desksLead: Analysts, operators, and executives share the same workspace — dashboards, charts, SQL, and datasets — without waiting on a report factory.
desk0Body: Publish a dashboard once. Filters, Jinja templating, and CSS templates turn it into an interactive, on-brand briefing — cached so the next open is fast.
desk0Feat0Body: Dashboard filters and Jinja templating let one board serve many questions without a rebuild.
desk0Feat1Body: CSS templates restyle charts and dashboards to your organisation’s look — not a generic BI skin.
desk0Feat2Body: Chart and dashboard caching keeps load times short when the same view is opened all morning.
desk1Title: No-code when you want it. SQL when you don’t.
desk1Body: The viz builder is drag-and-drop: pick a dataset, pick a chart, ship. When the question is sharper than a click, the same product still speaks SQL.
desk1Feat0Body: Build charts without writing a query. Metrics, dimensions, and a live preview in one canvas.
desk1Feat1Body: Big numbers, time series, maps, tables, and more — pre-installed, not a catalogue you buy later.
desk1Feat2Body: Need a viz the box does not ship? The plug-in architecture lets FDS or your team add it without forking the core.
desk2Title: A real SQL IDE, next to the board.
desk2Body: Write, run, and iterate against the warehouse. Save a query as a virtual dataset and the rest of Focal BI can chart it — no extract job in between.
desk2Feat0Body: Schema browser, results grid, and history — built for analysts who still think in SELECT.
desk2Feat1Body: Turn an ad-hoc query into a reusable dataset for exploration and dashboards.
desk2Feat2Body: SQL Lab hits the engine you connected. No shadow copy, no mystery cube.
desk3Title: A semantic layer the charts can share.
desk3Body: Physical tables, virtual datasets, metrics, and calculated columns live here — so Chart Builder and SQL Lab are not inventing the same KPI twice.
desk3Feat0Body: SQL transformations in the semantic layer keep business logic out of every dashboard.
desk3Feat1Body: Virtual datasets let analysts explore without waiting for a warehouse ticket.
desk3Feat2Body: Define the number once. Dashboards and charts reuse it — less spreadsheet drift.
vizBody: Focal BI ships with 40+ pre-installed visualization types. Start from a big number or a map; extend with plug-ins when the story needs a shape Apache did not ship.
vizNeed: Screenshot the viz-type picker / Explore gallery with many chart icons visible (big number, line, bar, pie, table, map). Save as /assets/focal-bi/viz-gallery.png.
vizFeat0Body: The common charts are already there. You do not buy a viz pack to start.
vizFeat1Body: Custom visualizations hook the same architecture — FDS can brand or extend without a fork.
dbTitle: Query the engine you already paid for.
dbBody: Postgres, cloud warehouses, analytical engines at petabyte scale — if it speaks SQL, Focal BI can sit on top. Lightweight, scalable, no second copy of the estate.
dbNeed: Screenshot Settings → Database connections with at least two SQL engines (e.g. PostgreSQL + a cloud warehouse). Save as /assets/focal-bi/databases.png.
dbFeat0Body: Modern cloud-native engines included. Connectors, not a new lake.
dbFeat1Body: The architecture uses your existing infrastructure instead of demanding another pipeline.
capTitle: The controls serious boards actually need.
capLead: Beyond the four desks: caching, templating, drills, and flags so the platform can grow without a rewrite.
cap0Body: Charts and dashboards load from cache so the morning stand-up is not a warehouse queue.
cap1Body: Templated SQL plus dashboard filters make one board interactive for many audiences.
cap2Body: Match charts and dashboards to your brand instead of a default BI theme.
cap3Body: SQL data transformations live once, then feed every chart that needs them.
cap4Body: Click a mark on one chart and the rest of the dashboard follows.
cap5Body: Move from a total into the rows behind it without leaving the board.
cap6Body: Slice the same number by another dimension — time, office, product — in place.
cap7Body: Turn on new capabilities when your programme is ready, without a big-bang upgrade.
deepBody: Cross-filters, drill-to-detail, and drill-by turn a static pack into a conversation with the warehouse — still on the same dashboard, still on your SQL engine.
deepFeat0Body: One click on a category, region, or time bucket re-scopes every linked chart.
deepFeat1Body: From an aggregate to the underlying records — the path audit actually wants.
deepFeat2Body: Keep the metric, change the dimension, stay on the same board.
deepVideoNeed: Record 12–20s: open a dashboard, change a native filter, click a chart so others cross-filter. Silent, 1920×1080. Save as /assets/focal-bi/interactive.mp4.
drillVideoNeed: Record 10–18s: drill-to-detail on a chart, then drill-by a second dimension. Save as /assets/focal-bi/drill.mp4.
ctaTitle: Ready for boards the business will actually open?
ctaSubtitle: We will walk Focal BI — Apache Superset, customized by FDS — against your warehouse, your roles, and how enquiry lands with us.
